title: European Database on Catheter-directed Treatment of Pulmonary Embolism.
brief_summary: The main goals of EuroPE-CDT is to assess the currently applied catheter-directed treatment (CTD) techniques and strategies in pulmonary embolism (PE) patients and to determine the short term efficacy and safety of this invasive procedure.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* acute pulmonary embolism
* catheter-directed embolectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* appropriate data not available
